rules.label: WITCH = DESTINATION
rules.locomotion: Purposeful walk uphill; approved T1 route/timing unchanged.
constraints: Does not hunt villagers, divert toward screams, help anyone or react meaningfully to surrounding destruction.
Does not avoid Blood or Bone. She knows her creations cannot meaningfully harm her.
Supernatural blood originating from her power flows/melds around her instead of injuring her, even if an attack intersects her position.
Bone trajectories passing near her are intentional; accidental attacks on her are essentially irrelevant.
rules.future_planning: Do not move her route to improve attack compositions or make her dodge. No additional route or Mayor encounter in Step 2B.

rules.label: BLOOD = CONCENTRATION
rules.selection: Prefer substantial concentrations over the nearest individual.
preferences: Crowds and people gathering for safety
rules.identity: Slower and more deliberate than Bone; overwhelming force. Relatively predictable once his selected concentration is understood.
rules.limit: Approved first strike at +56 only. No second target, strike or onward route is selected here.

rules.label: BONE = ATTENTION
rules.selection: An intelligent, malicious attention process, not a systematic clearance route or kill maximizer.
identity: Erratic, cruelly playful and easily redirected by a meaningful stimulus
Can observe, stalk, pursue, let someone run/hide, cut off a way, change angle or abandon an encounter
Does not need to finish a household, area or target before moving on
possible_stimuli: A sound or a shutting door
A watcher, a protective gesture or a group reaction
An interesting attempted escape or vantage point
A familiar place/memory or loss of interest
rules.precision: When he intends to hit something, he does not miss. Any apparent near-miss is deliberate.
rules.recording: Every major movement records its attention trigger. Short traversal bends around existing obstacles are locomotion, not invented new targets.

rules.label: BARRIER = BOUNDARY / REACTIVE WEAPON
rules.selection: Once fully active, physical interaction or attempting to cross can provoke a lethal response.
constraints: No indiscriminate firing into the village.
The sealed-but-translucent interval +60–90 is not retroactively treated as the fully active weapon phase.
Exact lashes, spikes, tendrils, VFX and attack forms remain undecided.
No civilian barrier contact or barrier attack is simulated in Step 2B.
rules.formation_inherited_from: t1_simulation.json: barrier geometry, fronts, closure and light curve unchanged.

iteration_rule.next_phase: Step 3: first civilian reaction, starting at the +90 handoff.
iteration_rule.gate: Simulate what the surviving villagers try to do before selecting/executing the next major Witch, Blood, Bone or barrier actions. Their reactions create stimuli for the following action phase. Do not pre-author the full massacre.

boss_reveal_order.first_player_experience: Witch boss fight: forming barrier, closure around 60 seconds, darkening/solidifying, full reactive activity around 90 seconds.
boss_reveal_order.later_revelation: Only after defeating the Witch does the player see the massacre reconstruction and recognize that this boss mechanic once sealed the village.
boss_reveal_order.implementation: Narrative intent only. No boss, cutscene, VFX or gameplay implementation.
